body:
## Context

Release-audit BLOCKER (undeclared breaking change; release-blockers.md, plugin:adlc-pi), reproduced end-to-end: in a throwaway git repo with no .adlc, no ticket, no ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, checkHandoff denies at 65% context fill (HANDOFF_PCT=60), creates .adlc state in the never-opted-in repo, stays sticky after fill cools, and follows the repository into every later session. Every mutating recovery verb requires ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, which the target user does not have.

On HEAD 867b93c: checkHandoff is deliberately first in the tool_call handler, before the no-ticket early return (plugins/adlc-pi/lib/extension.mjs:336-359 — the no-ticket deny is pinned as INTENDED by test/handoff-deny.test.mjs:305-316 and stays); pi's percent signal is real (extension.mjs:88-95); there is NO .adlc guard anywhere in the pi adapter; the deny text (lib/handoff-gate.mjs:244-248) says "continue in a fresh session", which is FALSE (cross-session sticky), and names verbs the user cannot run without the key. pi DOES already thread ticketId (extension.mjs:346).

Containment-only scope (Chris, 2026-08-22): key-free recovery machinery and deny re-scoping are follow-up tickets. IMPORTANT nuance found during verification: `runUnlock` (packages/context-handoff/bin/handoff.mjs:1012) appears to be the ONLY mutating verb WITHOUT requireKeyOrExit — verify its real key posture during the build; if unlock is genuinely keyless, the deny text SHOULD name it as the primary keyless recovery, with manual file removal as the fallback wording.

## What to change

1. `lib/handoff-gate.mjs` (:220 area) — return allow when `.adlc` does not exist under root (existsSync guard, mirroring codex adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1073). A repo that never installed ADLC must never be denied and never gain .adlc state.
2. `lib/handoff-gate.mjs` deny text (:244-248) — replace the false "continue in a fresh session" tail with a trusted-local recovery diagnostic: the session id, the host-side recovery command, and — when no ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is configured — the exact keyless path (verified-keyless `adlc handoff unlock`, or the exact files to remove: .adlc/handoffs/denies/<session>.json and the .adlc/.deny-store entry).
3. Docs — add a handoff-gate section to plugins/adlc-pi/README.md and docs/integrations/pi.md (what the gate watches, when it denies, that installing ADLC in the repo is the opt-in, and the recovery path). Neither file mentions the gate today.
4. Tests — additive: non-ADLC dir at 65% fill allows and creates no .adlc/; deny text contains the recovery tail (and the keyless wording when no key is configured). The pinned no-ticket deny test (:305-316) is NOT amended.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Non-ADLC directory is inert at any fill percent: allow, and no .adlc/ created. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new containment test present.
2. Deny text names the session id, a recovery command, and a keyless path when no key is configured. verify: same suite asserts the substrings; exits 0.
3. The gate is documented in both docs. verify: `grep -qi 'handoff' plugins/adlc-pi/README.md && grep -qi 'handoff' docs/integrations/pi.md` exits 0.
4. Whole plugin suite green (including the untouched no-ticket deny pin). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: pi: handoff gate contained to ADLC repos; deny text names a keyless recovery; the gate is documented
